decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album 'Crazy World'. Source D1S1 explicitly states 'Crazy World is the third studio album by American pop rock band Boys Like Girls', identifying Boys Like Girls as the artist of the album. Source D2S10 mentions 'One Direction Set To Release 'Crazy World' EP', identifying One Direction as the artist of an EP with the same title. Since distinct artists can legitimately release works with identical titles (as noted in the instructions), and the sources distinguish between the 'album' (Boys Like Girls) and the 'EP' (One Direction), both are valid answers to the query regarding the entity associated with the title 'Crazy World' in the provided context. The instruction to keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner applies here.
